compliance.summary: The page presents GoGloby as a company that builds and maintains custom voice AI systems, an offer that conflicts with its recruiting and staffing positioning. The case-study results, anonymous client claims, and related metrics are not supported by the company sources; decide whether to retain the page before correcting those claims.

llm_problems.title: Custom AI development positioning
llm_problems.issue: The page presents GoGloby as building production voice AI systems rather than as a staffing and recruiting agency.
llm_problems.fix: Rework the page’s main message to match GoGloby’s approved staffing and recruiting positioning.

llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers
